name: cc-immerse
description: Learn a language while you work in Claude Code. Read replies in the language you are learning, with your own one click away; what you type is translated or corrected as you go. 22 languages.

nativeLanguage.title: Immerse · Your language
nativeLanguage.description: The language you already read and write. Translations and correction notes are written in it, and what you type in it is sent in the language you are learning.

targetLanguage.title: Immerse · Language you are learning
targetLanguage.description: The language you work in. Replies in it get a translation on request, and what you type in it is corrected.

readingLevel.title: Immerse · Level
readingLevel.description: Off: nothing is done to replies. 1 and 2: you and Claude talk in your language, and the language you are learning is shown as a translation (1: on a click, 2: beside the reply). 3 and 4: you and Claude talk in the language you are learning; what you type in your language is sent in it, with your own words beside it so no meaning is lost (3: your language beside the reply, 4: on a click). /immerse shows each of them.

typingHelp.title: Immerse · Help while typing
typingHelp.description: A line above the prompt box as you type: your draft in the language you are learning, or as it would read corrected. And a correction under what you sent in the language you are learning.
